data.body: PR #34 at 456a5be. Both entry points now populate the three budget fields from BudgetCaps.from_settings. The first GitHub CI run failed on the new demo test because it reached the Jira acceptance-field lookup, which loads the untracked operator file config/local/jira.yaml. Reproduced locally by moving that file aside, fixed by stubbing the lookup the way the intake reconciler tests already do, and re-falsified with the file still hidden. Plan review signed PASS 0 blocking 0 advisory. Code review PASS 0 blocking 0 advisory. Local inv ci 1526 passed 6 skipped eval-gate PASS. GitHub CI pass in 3m01s. All five selectors proven individually and each assertion falsified by wiring a wrong constant in its place.
